verifier: Trust Proof Security Reliability Release Engine independent verifier

attack.hypothesis: Append-only audit_events triggers do not protect or correlate the authoritative payroll business audit embedded in tenant state.

rootCause.description: Payroll business evidence is split between an append-only audit_events table and an unsealed payrollControl.audit array inside mutable tenant JSON. The runtime has no startup/read/export invariant that correlates consequential adjustment/export state with both ledgers, so direct state tampering is not detected.
rootCause.workingControl: Database triggers reject UPDATE and DELETE against audit_events.
rootCause.missingControl: Cryptographic or independently verified correlation between payroll state, embedded business audit, command audit and export identity.

requiredRepair: Bind each consequential payroll transition to an immutable sequence/hash chain or equivalent independently verifiable ledger.
Correlate stored adjustment/export identities and checksums with command audit and business audit at startup and before read/download.
Fail closed and emit recovery evidence when any ledger entry is missing, reordered, forged or inconsistent.
Add known-good restore and reconciliation proof; a backup alone is insufficient.
nextProof: Make this fail-first regression pass against a newly sealed artifact, then repeat authenticated adjustment, restart, audit correlation, export and known-good restore on the exact Node 22 Docker candidate.
safety: No hosted deployment, live database, customer record, payroll record, credential, DNS or infrastructure was changed.
